title: 皐月賞の後に・プリテンディング

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner of the Satsuki Sho, the first of the Classic Triple Crown, is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gasp… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin has emerged victorious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh… My head hurts. Ugh… But still…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I won! Hah! I hope all my haters saw that! They'll never say I'm not good enough ever again!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What happened in that race? And what is this feeling?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Urk!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I still feel so overwhelmed by the intensity in her voice!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket, are you…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What if this had been the Derby? I… I would've lost…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! This is no time to show weakness! I gotta stay STRONG!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be the Derby Champion! I WILL make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide returns to the waiting room with a dark expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This is all because I let myself become arrogant… Or maybe it means there's a flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And if that's the case, I simply need to find a way to fix it. Everything will be fine. There has to be a solution.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This was but the result of a miscalculation and nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As long as I fix it, the equation should behave predictably, and I won't have to worry about ever losing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her voice keeps getting smaller and smaller until she's nearly inaudible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever the miscalculation was, she seems pretty shaken. She must have discovered something worrying. Still…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket is tenacious and persists at full speed until the very end… And the ferocity of Taishin's pursuit is unparalleled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Both of them are first-class competitors in their own right. They're incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What could have happened in this race to make them outliers in her calculations?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I might have lost, but at least I've obtained new data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's reanalyze things right away. There's not much time left until the Derby, so we can't waste any time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next stop on our journey together is the second race of the Classic Triple Crown tour—the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But hearing such urgency in her voice makes me worry that something in her is beginning to crack.
